acceptance: Live adapter returned a valid practice evaluation (P1 xiaolin, 请给我一杯茶。 -> order_drink drink=tea) and a boss evaluation with coach null (B1 laozhou, 我要一张去海港的票。 -> buy_ticket destination=haigang quantity=1) on gemini-3-flash-preview, two consecutive runs, ~1.2-1.4 s per call; credentials kept out of artifacts.

Every live and fixture evaluation is validated with shared schemas and validateEvaluationForContext; invented slot values, out-of-scene intents, non-substring evidence and boss coaching are rejected as PROVIDER_INVALID_OUTPUT.
23 documented language examples exercised through the fixture provider; 6/6 designated valid Mandarin intents pass the progression gate; English-only and prompt-injection examples fail it.

Timeout (8 s budget), quota (429, no retry) and transient 5xx (one retry) map to recoverable 503 errors without mutating game state; fixture provider is labeled 'fixture' and asks for clarification on any undocumented input.
System-override dialogue yields unknown/irrelevant evaluations with no slots, so it cannot satisfy a state transition or reward.
manualEvidence: scripts/smoke-gemini.ts PASS for practice and boss on gemini-3-flash-preview (live account call).
limitations: Spec default gemini-3.8-flash returned 503 (high demand) and gemini-2.5-flash is unavailable to new users; the verified model is gemini-3-flash-preview, set via GEMINI_MODEL.
Game routes that call the provider belong to Segment-001; Segment-002 is exercised through unit tests and the smoke script only.
apps/server/tests/providers.test.ts (Segment-000) was minimally updated to stop a dummy key from triggering a live call; see .build/proposals/Segment-002.md.
